title: InDrop Library Preparation - TruDrop (modified V2)
author: Austin Southard-Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9ngh5bw
materials: If necessary, thaw samples on ice.
When the SSS reaction has 50 minutes remaining move the contents of the NEB HiScribe T7 High Yield RNA Synthesis Kit to an ice bucket to start thawing On ice (leave the T7 enzyme at -20 °C ).

When the SSS reaction has 10-15 minutes remaining prepare enough of the following IVT master mix On ice for each sample using the NEB HiScribe T7 Kigh Yield RNA Synthesis Kit reagents (mix by pipetting): Reagent Volume/Reaction UltraPure DNase/Rnase-free H2O 10 µL NEB T7 High Yield 10x rxn buffer 8 µL ATP 8 µL CTP 8 µL GTP 8 µL UTP 8 µL NEB T7 High Yield Enzyme Mix 8 µL Pyrophosphatase (NEB M0361S) 2 µL
N-1 times (a total of N adjusted cycles).
Do step 123 for all other samples.

steps.title: Estimate sample volume
steps.instruction: While samples are thawing, visually estimate the volume of each sample and record the value.

steps.title: Prepare Digest mix
steps.instruction: For every 70 µL of post‑RT material prepare 100 µL of Digest mix: 86 µL Ultrapure RNase/DNase‑free H₂O, 9 µL 10X Fast Digest Buffer, 5 µL Exonuclease I. Mix H₂O and buffer first, then add and mix Exonuclease I while the sample is spinning in step 4.

steps.title: Pellet residual oil
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 4 °C for 5 min at 16 000 × g to pellet residual HFE‑7500 oil.

steps.title: Transfer sample to Spin‑X column
steps.instruction: Adjust the pipette to the estimated sample volume, block the tip with Digest mix, draw the sample without pulling oil from the bottom, set the pipette to the exact volume, record it, and eject the sample directly above the filter of a Costar Spin‑X column (do not let it run down the sides).

steps.title: Add Digest mix to column
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Digest mix to the filter column for every 70 µL of sample (calculate: sample µL ÷ 0.7 = Digest µL). Record the volume added and pipette the Digest mix directly above the sample (do not insert tip into the sample).

steps.title: Repeat sample‑Digest addition
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 4–5 for all samples.

steps.title: First AMPure bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of AMPure XP beads to each sample (calculate based on desired bead‑to‑sample ratio), mix by pipetting until no mixing lines are observed using the same tip that added the beads. Do NOT vortex. Pre‑chill one 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube and one Spin‑X column + collection tube on ice for each sample. Bring a 2 mL aliquot of AMPure beads to room temperature to equilibrate.

steps.title: Pass sample through Spin‑X
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter column and collection tube at 4 °C for 5 min at 16 000 × g to pass the sample through the filter.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Place samples on ice, adjust pipette to total volume, block tip with Digest mix, draw the eluate from the collection tube, set pipette to the exact volume, record it, and eject the eluate into a pre‑chilled 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube (eject at the bottom, avoid side walls).

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at 37 °C for 30 min. During incubation, keep 10X Second Strand Synthesis (SSS) Reaction Buffer on ice to start thawing.

steps.title: Resuspend AMPure beads (first aliquot)
steps.instruction: Vortex the AMPure bead aliquot for 5–10 s to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Calculate bead volume for 0.8× purification
steps.instruction: Using the measured sample volume, calculate AMPure XP bead volume as 0.8 × sample volume (e.g., 165 µL × 0.8 = 132 µL).

steps.title: First bead‑sample incubation
steps.instruction: Add the calculated AMPure bead volume to each sample, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (first)
steps.instruction: Place each tube on a magnetic rack for 2 min at room temperature (or until beads fully separate).

steps.title: Supernatant removal (first)
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet, pipetting from the side opposite the pellet. Do not touch beads.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (first)
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 80 % ethanol (400 µL per wash) at room temperature. For each wash, rotate tube 180°, pipette ethanol onto the side opposite the beads, and avoid disturbing the pellet. If beads stick, tap the tube side or gently move the tube on the magnet to free them.

steps.title: Quick‑spin after ethanol washes
steps.instruction: After the second ethanol wash, quick‑spin tubes in a mini‑centrifuge for 1 s at room temperature to collect residual ethanol.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol (first)
steps.instruction: Place tubes back on the magnet rack and use a P200 or smaller pipette to remove any remaining ethanol from the bottom (do not touch beads).

steps.title: Air‑dry beads (first)
steps.instruction: Leave tubes open on the magnetic rack for 5–10 min at room temperature until the bead pellet is matte black and not cracked. While drying, pre‑chill one PCR tube per sample on a 96‑well aluminum block on ice and cover to prevent dust.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads (first)
steps.instruction: Add 17 µL Ultrapure DNase/RNase‑free H₂O to each dry bead pellet, flick tube bottom to resuspend (do NOT vortex), and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare SSS buffer for elution
steps.instruction: While elution incubates, mix thawed 10X SSS buffer by pipetting and add 2 µL to each chilled PCR tube.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Spin the sample tubes in a mini‑centrifuge for 1 s at room temperature, then place on the magnet rack for ~10 s to pellet beads. Transfer the supernatant (≈17 µL) to the chilled PCR tube using a P20 pipette (avoid carrying beads forward).

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis reaction
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme mix to each PCR tube, mix by pipetting (≈10 up‑and‑down motions) until few or no mixing lines remain.

steps.title: Run SSS thermal cycler program
steps.instruction: Program the PCR machine: 16 °C 2 min 30 s, 65 °C 20 s, hold at 4 °C, lid 50 °C. Do not place samples until block reaches 16 °C.

steps.title: Post‑SSS quick‑spin
steps.instruction: After the SSS reaction, quick‑spin PCR tubes for 2 s at room temperature.

steps.title: In Vitro Transcription (IVT) master mix addition
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL IVT master mix to each PCR tube at room temperature, mix by pipetting until no mixing lines are observed.

steps.title: Run IVT thermal cycler program
steps.instruction: Program the PCR machine: 37 °C 15 min, lid 50 °C. Do not place samples until block reaches 37 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend AMPure beads (second aliquot)
steps.instruction: Vortex the second AMPure bead aliquot (2 mL) for 5–10 s to resuspend.

steps.title: Second AMPure bead cleanup (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Add 72 µL AMPure beads to each IVT reaction, mix by pipetting (do NOT vortex), and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 2 min at room temperature (or until beads fully separate).

steps.title: Supernatant removal (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant carefully from the side opposite the bead pellet (do not touch beads).

steps.title: Ethanol washes (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 400 µL 80 % ethanol as described in step 19, rotating 180° each time and avoiding disturbance of the pellet.

steps.title: Quick‑spin after post‑IVT washes
steps.instruction: Quick‑spin tubes for 1 s at room temperature, then remove residual ethanol on the magnet rack with a P200 or smaller pipette (do not touch beads).

steps.title: Air‑dry beads (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Leave tubes open on the magnetic rack for 5 min at room temperature. While drying, pre‑chill one PCR tube and one 0.5 mL DNA LoBind tube per sample on ice, cover to prevent dust.

steps.title: Elute RNA from beads (post‑IVT)
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL RNA Elution Buffer to each dry bead pellet, flick to resuspend (no vortex), incubate 5 min at room temperature, then spin 1 s, place on magnet for ~10 s, and transfer the 8 µL supernatant to the chilled PCR tube using a P20 pipette (avoid beads).

steps.title: Prepare RT master mix (first)
steps.instruction: On ice, thaw 1× PrimeScript RT buffer, 100 µM TruDrop PE2‑N6 primer, and dNTPs. Mix each component by pipetting until no lines remain.

steps.title: Second bead‑based cleanup (post‑RT)
steps.instruction: Place each sample tube on magnetic rack for 2 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant as in step 20, wash beads twice with 400 µL 80 % ethanol (rotate 180° each wash), quick‑spin 1 s, and remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads (post‑RT)
steps.instruction: Air‑dry beads on the magnetic rack for 5 min at room temperature. While drying, pre‑chill one PCR tube and one 0.5 mL DNA LoBind tube per sample on ice.

steps.title: Elute RNA (post‑RT)
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL RNA Elution Buffer to each dry bead pellet, flick to resuspend (no vortex), incubate 5 min at room temperature, spin 1 s, place on magnet for 15 s, and transfer 20 µL supernatant to a chilled 0.5 mL DNA LoBind tube (backup) and 9 µL to a chilled PCR tube (sample). Avoid carrying beads forward.

steps.title: Incubate RT reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate each sample/bead mixture at room temperature for 5 min while thawing TruDrop PE1/PE2 indexed 5 µM primer mixes on ice and preparing any additional 80 % ethanol.

steps.title: Second magnetic separation (post‑RT)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnetic rack for 2 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant as before, and wash beads twice with 400 µL 80 % ethanol (rotate 180° each wash).

steps.title: Final bead‑dry and elution (post‑RT)
steps.instruction: Quick‑spin 1 s, remove residual ethanol, air‑dry beads for 2 min, then add 40 µL DNA Elution Buffer, flick to resuspend, incubate 5 min at room temperature, spin 1 s, place on magnet for 15 s, and transfer 40 µL supernatant to a chilled 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube (final library).

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with Qubit DNA HS assay (use 2 µL sample). Expected concentration 1–3 ng/µL.

steps.title: Store libraries
steps.instruction: Store completed libraries at –80 °C until sequencing.

steps.title: Sequencing preparation
steps.instruction: Treat libraries as normal TruSeq libraries: use standard TruSeq sequencing primers. Recommended NovaSeq settings – Paired‑End 50 bp (or more) for both reads, i7 8 cycles, i5 8 cycles.

steps.title: Index pooling guidelines
steps.instruction: When pooling TruDrop libraries with other Illumina libraries, use each i7/i5 index pair only once per lane. Follow the detailed UDI ordering tables provided for pools of 1‑8, 9‑16, or 17‑24 libraries, avoiding UDI0009.
